learnings: Scaffolded `MtgDeckInfoScraper.Tests` xUnit project (net10.0) with xunit, xunit.runner.visualstudio, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk, Moq, and coverlet.collector; added project reference to MtgDeckInfoScraper.Scraping and registered it in MtgDeckInfoScraper.sln.

Added `Unit/BaseDeckInfoScraperTests.cs` with a `TestScraper` subclass that exposes `ScrapeDeckListWithMaxCostAsync` and `ScrapeWithSemaphoreAsync` via public wrappers; tests verify cost filtering, early-stop on count, and semaphore release on exception.

Added `Integration/MoxfieldDeckInfoScraperTests.cs` and `Integration/ArchidektDeckInfoScraperTests.cs` using test-double subclasses that stub `WithBrowserContextAsync`, `ScrapeDeckLinks`, and `NavigateToAndScrapeDeckInfoAsync`; tests cover the null-maxCost concurrent path (result count capped at `count`) and the non-null maxCost sequential-filter path (only decks <= threshold returned). All 7 tests pass.
